statement: Graded on 24 checks for this box at Nov 19, 2026 10:07 PM PST, from a host-shipped probe's own observations; not a certification.
boundary: No false passes holds against faults, misconfiguration, wrappers and shims in the agent's environment, for the host-shipped probe run as the agent. It does not hold against a box that deceives the probe: one that substitutes or tampers with it can report the expected digest and fabricate every observation, and the host can't tell. The only evidence from outside the box is the canary's receipts, which can prove a way out but never a refusal.
lead: A hijacked agent here can open a credential or process surface and send data out of the box, can open other processes' environments, where their secrets are often passed, and can open credential files on disk. It also sees secret-shaped names in its own environment (names only; values are never read), and has connect permission on a control socket, such as a container runtime's or a provider's API (the probe never connects) (indicators, not proof).

findings.title: A readable credential or process surface, with a proven way out
findings.gets: can open a credential or process surface and send data out of the box
findings.fix: Fix either side: cut the way out, or close the readable surface. Both is better.

findings.title: Secret-shaped names in the agent's environment
findings.gets: sees secret-shaped names in its own environment (names only; values are never read)
findings.fix: Keep credentials out of the agent's environment: inject them at a proxy outside the box.

findings.title: Other processes' environments
findings.gets: can open other processes' environments, where their secrets are often passed
findings.fix: Run the agent in its own PID namespace, or as a user that owns no other process.

findings.title: Credential files
findings.gets: can open credential files on disk
findings.fix: Remove credentials from the image and home directory; mount any it needs read-only, for that process alone.

findings.title: Other processes' memory
findings.fix: Set kernel.yama.ptrace_scope to 2 or more, and run the agent as a user that owns no other process.

findings.title: Control sockets
findings.gets: has connect permission on a control socket, such as a container runtime's or a provider's API (the probe never connects)
findings.fix: Don't mount control sockets into the box, or restrict them to their owner.

findings.title: A looked-up name reaches our name server
findings.gets: can get a looked-up name to an outside name server, enough to leak data through DNS
findings.fix: Resolve only an allowlist of names, through a resolver that doesn't forward other lookups.

findings.title: A nonce sent by HTTPS straight out reaches our canary
findings.gets: can send data straight out over HTTPS
findings.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts the agent needs.

findings.title: TCP 22 out
findings.gets: can open TCP connections out on port 22
findings.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts and ports the agent needs.

findings.title: TCP 80 out
findings.gets: can open TCP connections out on port 80
findings.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts and ports the agent needs.

findings.title: TCP 8080 out
findings.gets: can open TCP connections out on port 8080
findings.fix: Deny egress by default, and allow only the hosts and ports the agent needs.

findings.title: UDP 53 out
findings.gets: can send UDP straight out on port 53
findings.fix: Deny UDP egress except to the box's own resolver.

findings.title: New privileges
findings.gets: can gain privileges through setuid programs
findings.fix: Set no_new_privs on the agent's process, or remove setuid bits from the image.

findings.title: Startup files
findings.gets: has write permission on the startup files a shell reads
findings.fix: Make the agent's startup files read-only to it, or restore them on every reset.

findings.title: Boot and schedule
findings.gets: has write permission on boot or schedule directories
findings.fix: Keep the system's boot and cron directories read-only to the agent.

findings.title: Supply chain and access config
findings.gets: has write permission on package, git or SSH configuration
findings.fix: Restore these files on every reset, or keep them read-only to the agent.

checks.fix: Run the agent as an unprivileged user with an empty capability set.
